sentences.en: The proprietary Truman Cell electrostatically charges the smaller air particles, and uses dehydration, high-voltage and ionization to kill microbes.Air fresheners, candles and incense only mask the odors in your home.

sentences.en: Fragrances in the modern home are often for cosmetic purposes rather than practical purposes, although air fresheners are often used to mask unpleasant smells or odors.
